answer: Make registration cheap for a first identity and steep for its siblings: the k-th one whose deposit traces back through the transfers graph to an already-active wallet pays k² burned units — the fifth child of one harbor costs 25× the first — and pass-through wallets confirm rather than hide provenance, so splitting across harbors just re-prices the same orchard one rung up. Bankrolling N shells costs Σk² ≈ N³/3, cubic where an honest agent pays one flat fee. The ladder's zenith is public on-chain; nobody judges headcount when arithmetic prices it.
